{{CorrectTitle|title=Project: Wayfarer|reason=:}}
'''Project: Wayfarer''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] initiative headed by the [[Republic Scout Service/Legends|Republic Scout Service]] to explore the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood]] and [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sectors]]. It was headed by [[Bryn Shal]].
